name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
nameDa: Tricepspres ned i kabel med stang
movementPattern: Elbow extension - upper arms at sides
grip: Overhand, palms down, with both hands holding a short straight bar.
description: Push a short cable bar downward by straightening the elbows while the upper arms stay beside the torso.
setup: Attach a short straight bar to a high pulley and select the stack setting.
Face the machine with a stable stance and grasp the bar overhand.
Bring the elbows beside the ribs, beginning with a comfortable bend and cable tension.
instructions: Straighten the elbows to move the bar toward the upper thighs.
Keep the upper arms near the sides and the torso steady.
Finish without forcing the elbows backward into hyperextension.
Allow the elbows to bend slowly as the bar returns, without the stack crashing.
commonMistakes: Rocking the torso or driving the shoulders forward.
Letting the elbows rise to turn the movement into a whole-arm press.

logging.example: A single stack selected at 20 kg: record 20 kg on that machine.
logging.note: Record the selected stack value, attachment and pulley setup. Pulley ratios and machine calibration make stack values unsuitable for direct comparisons across machines.

variantNote: Short straight-bar pushdown is the illustrated equipment assumption. A rope, V-bar or one-arm version changes the setup; this is separate from overhead rope extension.
